briefdescription.para: Scaling factor that converts JUCE normalised trackpad deltas to line-sized units before accumulation.

detaileddescription.para: JUCE normalises smooth-scroll deltas to approximately 1.0 / lines-per-notch, yielding values around 0.05–0.15 per frame at typical trackpad velocity. After multiplying by the user's terminalScrollStep (default 5), the raw product is still sub-line (~0.25–0.75). This factor bridges the gap so that a natural finger swipe produces a comfortable number of scrolled lines without requiring multiple frames to cross the first whole-line threshold.
